title: MG forms and witness statements
purpose: Structural and realism reference for fictional test-document generation only.

structural_fields.name: form_reference
structural_fields.notes: MG code e.g. MG11 / MG11M / MG11 Cont

structural_fields.name: pti_urn
structural_fields.notes: Pre-trial information unique reference number for the investigation

structural_fields.name: defendant_or_suspect_name
structural_fields.notes: Often present on case-linked forms; may be anonymised on some witness copies

structural_fields.name: statement_body
structural_fields.notes: Narrative evidence; may span continuation sheets

structural_fields.name: signature_and_date
structural_fields.notes: Witness signature/date; officer countersign where applicable

structural_fields.name: consent_medical_records
structural_fields.notes: MG11 records consent for medical records use

realistic_density_and_continuation.continuation_behaviour: Blank typed continuation sheets (electronic MG11) or lined handwritten MG11M Cont; page-of-pages consecutive; declaration typically on final page.
realistic_density_and_continuation.whitespace_pattern: Header dense; narrative mid-density paragraphs or lined manuscript; signature block near foot of final page.
realistic_density_and_continuation.overflow_rules: Do not squeeze declaration onto cramped last lines; spill narrative to Cont page before signatures.

tables_signatures_identifiers.tables: Usually not tabular for MG11; MG09/MG10 use row-per-witness tables.
tables_signatures_identifiers.signatures: Wet-ink or electronic signature zone; date adjacent; officer endorsement separate.
tables_signatures_identifiers.identifiers: PTI URN prominent; exhibit marks referenced in narrative as 'I produce exhibit AB/1'.
tables_signatures_identifiers.chequered_banding: Some MG forms use chequered banding to denote non-disclosable content (e.g. MG6 family sensitive variants).

common_document_relationships.relation: MG02 feeds special-measures application; ABE video may accompany MG11/MG15
MG11 produces exhibits listed on MG12
Unused drafts/notes may appear on MG6C/MG6D
MG15 interview record pairs with audio/visual interview for suspects/ABE

safe_fictionalisation_rules: Use wholly invented names, addresses, DOBs, phone numbers, URN/PTI numbers, exhibit marks, and force identifiers.
Do not reproduce protected personal data from real cases, private case papers, or non-public force templates.
Prefer clearly fictional markers (e.g. 'FX-' URNs, 'Anytown', invented force codes) while preserving structural realism.
Do not copy Crown copyright form artwork/logos beyond structural field labels described in public guidance.
Where exact blank-form layout is unpublished, record layout confidence as inferred_from_guidance and avoid pixel-perfect claims.
Invent witness narrative consistent with charged facts; avoid copying published case-study wording from training packs.
Keep special-measures flags structurally present without fabricating clinical diagnoses.
visual_qa_requirements: Form code and URN visible in header region on every page.
Continuation pages show Cont designation and consecutive page numbering.
Declaration/signature not orphaned mid-page without preceding narrative close.
Protective marking present; chequered banding only on forms that public guidance marks non-disclosable.
No real crest artwork required; placeholder header label acceptable if noted.
prohibited_copying_or_unsupported_assump: No private case papers, custody-system screenshots, or force intranet templates.
No real victim/witness/defendant identifiers, phone numbers, IMEIs, vehicle registrations, or medical identifiers.
No reproduction of protected sensitive/PII schedules containing real sensitive material.
No claim that this register is a substitute for live CrimPR/Practice Direction forms.
No coupling to V2.1.2 renderer implementation; this pack is reference-only.
Do not treat commercial MG blank downloads as authoritative unless they match public GOV.UK purpose descriptions.
Do not invent compulsory fields beyond those evidenced in public MG purpose summaries and NFS annex references.

subtypes.title: Further Report to CPS for Charging Decision

notes: National File Standard (Director’s Guidance 6th ed.) determines which MG forms appear in GAP/NGAP/Crown Court builds. Digital Case File rollout may later absorb MG forms; interim register retains MG structure.
